Measure what matters.

Guidance and important context +

For ages 16 and above. Teen plans exclude weight-loss targets and maximal-effort testing. Choose your ability, not a gender label. Consult a qualified professional if you have a medical condition, injury, recent surgery, pregnancy or postpartum recovery.

Stop and seek urgent help for chest pain, fainting or severe breathing difficulty. Generic performance goals are independent of armed forces and do not provide official test scores.
